description: Independent query expectations for this backend storage and implemented shader paths, not original Microsoft D3D9 measurements. Color formats come from the frozen pre-query layout reference. SDK query bits and resources are separate from production functions.
notes: Filtering of float32 needs enabled host bit 0, blending needs bit 1. sRGB follows physical sRGB views; writes/blending additionally require supported color targets. Vertex texture YES is limited to pixel-verified 2D VS3 color formats. Programmable software vertex textures, cube/volume VTF, depth VTF/raw-depth filtering and legacy bump queries stay conservative NO. Layout/create success is checked separately. BC storage additionally requires enabled host bit 2, including queries with usage zero; no CPU BC fallback exists in D3D.
